subject: SkyThread vendor setup — privacy, DPA, SOC 2, and PO routing
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Maria Silva <maria.silva@skythread.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SkyThread vendor setup — privacy & PO items

Hi Maria,

Great to connect yesterday. We're moving SkyThread through our procurement intake and need the following items to complete privacy/security gate and PO setup so finance can route invoices:

- Signed DPA (or DocuSign link we can accept).
- SOC 2 report or a read-only link to the control report (attestation + date).
- Full subprocessor inventory (names, purpose, locations) — a CSV is ideal.
- Preferred invoicing email and remittance instructions (bank details).
- Any tax forms or W-8/W-9 equivalent (if applicable for EU customers, VAT info).

If you can attach the DPA and the subprocessor CSV that will speed things up. We generally require the SOC 2 public link or a temporary share link so our security team can validate the date and scope.

Target: if we can get these by end of day Thursday (9/10) we can generate the PO and route to finance for net-30 processing. HubSpot deal is HS-8892 if you need that reference.

Thanks — cc'ing Laura from Legal/Procurement and Ben from Finance for routing.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Vendor Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_vendor_intake_form.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Maria Silva <maria.silva@skythread.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@skythread.io
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyThread vendor setup — privacy & PO items

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the note. Attached are the items you requested and a couple of clarifying notes:

- Attached: SkyThread_Subprocessors.csv (list & categories)
- Attached: SkyThread_SOC2_Report_Link.txt (private link to our SOC 2 Type II report; access expires in 30 days)
- Attached: SkyThread_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf (signed copy)

Invoicing: invoices should be sent to finance@skythread.io. We invoice Net 30; bank remittance details are included on page 2 of the PO stub attached. Our tax ID and EU VAT number are on the DPA cover sheet.

Question: do you need a specific PO number before we can start provisioning, or can we proceed on a provisional account while Redwood issues the formal PO?

--
Maria Silva
Head of Partnerships
SkyThread Inc.
maria.silva@skythread.io
(44) 20 7946 0321

Attachments: SkyThread_Subprocessors.csv, SkyThread_SOC2_Report_Link.txt, SkyThread_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyThread vendor setup — privacy & PO items

Hi all — quick follow-up from Procurement/Legal:

Thanks Maria — the DPA and subprocessors CSV look complete at a glance. We will run the SOC 2 link through security for verification (scope must include hosting/processing; I see that noted but security will confirm).

PO / invoicing notes:
- Redwood will issue PO RS-0004678 for the initial engagement.
- Please send invoices to invoices@redwood-inference.com and reference PO RS-0004678 on every invoice.
- For EU vendors, please include your VAT number on the invoice and specify "reverse charge" if applicable.

Next steps for SkyThread:
1) Confirm you received the PO number and will add it to future invoices.
2) Confirm the subprocessor list CSV contains a contact for each subprocessor — security may request clarification for two entries (CloudStore UK Ltd. and EdgeCache ApS).
3) If possible, confirm estimated go-live window for provisioning; procurement will mark the order pending until SOC 2 verification completes (typically 48 business hours).

HubSpot deal HS-8892 will be updated with the PO and links noted below. If there are any redlines on the DPA, send them back via the DocuSign thread; otherwise we'll consider the attached signed copy accepted.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Procurement & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/8892

Thanks Maria — all good on our side. Attaching the PO and I've uploaded the SOC 2 link to our secure docs folder for Security to review.

Attachments: PO_RS-0004678.pdf (PDF stub), SkyThread_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf

We can provision a provisional account today (limited quota) and will move to full capacity once Security confirms SOC 2 scope. Expected SOC 2 review turnaround: ~48 business hours.

Maria — please confirm you will add PO RS-0004678 to invoices and that finance@skythread.io will receive invoice submissions. Also confirm whether SkyThread needs an internal purchase order reference from Redwood for go-live scheduling.

Best,
